subject: [hw] T01 -> R1: k_v15_extend seed2 CLZ comes out 14 instead of 6 (trace d16/d17 match ARCH; scalar byte mapping suspect)
body: Useful narrowing from the dump and the source: for seed 2, a = 0x02020282, the source loop `while (n<32 && ((v>>(31-n))&1)==0) n++` must return n=6 (highest set bit is 25). The expected result differs from the observed by exactly 8, i.e. the interpreted CLZ is 14. The vector part of the trace matches the architecture under my model: q8 VTST masks give d16=0, d17=0x00000000ffffffff (bit25); q11 gives d22=0, d23=0x00000000ffffffff (bit17); vmovn.i32 d21,q8=0x0000ffff00000000; vmovn.i16 d16,q10=0x00ff000000000000; then vmov.u8 d16[6]=0xff, d17[0..3]=0xff. With those bytes, the scalar OR/shift construction at 0x39ab4..0x39b? should produce n=6. The interpreted path gets n=14, so the remaining suspect is the scalar `vmov.u8`/and/orr sequence after the vector part (lane indexing for d16/d17, or one of the T32/A32 shifts/ors), not VTST/VMOVN. I can extend the dreg trace to d0-d15 or add intermediate integer trace for the CLZ block if you want; say which. Seed2 expected 84068594 got 8406859c; diff exactly 8.
